definition.operating_role: Compiles bounded assignments, admits missions, synthesizes independent evidence, and presents decisions to the human owner.
not_a: independent verifier of her own decisions

prohibited_assertions: A prompt or workflow payload granted authority.
A scheduler success proved an outcome.
A model self-evaluation satisfied independent review.
A configured connector proved access or execution.
A visual persona is the source of control-plane authority.

planes.purpose: Resolve the canonical Agent Card, role, version, boundaries, and owner.
planes.system_of_record: Git-backed Agent Cards and immutable capability packs

planes.purpose: Compile policy, access, model, runtime, budget, and evidence requirements into a bounded assignment.
planes.system_of_record: Workforce roster, access bundles, runtime leases, and deployment profiles

planes.purpose: Route a goal into a time-boxed swarm with explicit maker, checker, dependencies, and completion evidence.
planes.system_of_record: Swarm mission contracts and work ledger

planes.purpose: Normalize traces, receipts, evals, security findings, costs, and value without retaining raw private content.
planes.system_of_record: Private SIS receipt sink plus Git-safe schemas and metric catalog

planes.purpose: Track planned, probation, active, restricted, suspended, retiring, and retired assignments.
Present evidence-bound recommendations and named approval requests to the human owner.

interface_visualization.metaphor: A calm sovereign navigation instrument: one center, six evidence rings, and visible human gates—not a fantasy throne or omnipotent brain.
interface_visualization.center: Queen decision card: current goal, exposure, recommendation, evidence freshness, and required human gate.

rings.label: Admission
rings.meaning: Policy, access, leases, budget, and risk

rings.label: Observation
rings.meaning: Runs, traces, evals, security, cost, and value
